title: Canonical proper-open site extension comparison
statement: Let $\Lambda:\mathrm{Type}(u+1)$ be a commutative ring, let $X,T:\mathrm{Scheme}_u$, and let $j:X\hookrightarrow T$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Use the bounded-below derived categories of constant-$\Lambda$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact etale extension by zero $J_j^e$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero], exact pro-etale extension by zero $J_j^p$ [def-weil-extension-by-zero], and exact site comparison $A_Z=\nu_Z^*$ [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. Define $o_j:A_TJ_j^e\xrightarrow{\sim}J_j^pA_X$ to be the bounded-below exact derived version of the canonical adjoint sheaf extension comparison of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-comparison]. More precisely, in Lean functor-composition order it is the inverse exact-derived-composition isomorphism, followed by the exact derived natural isomorphism of `openImmersionLowerShriekComparisonUpperStarIso`, followed by the exact-derived-composition isomorphism. This is the existing `properOpenSiteExtensionIso`; it requires neither finiteness of $\Lambda$, quasi-compactness of $j$, nor Noetherian hypotheses.

def properOpenSiteExtensionIso (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X T : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ T) [IsOpenImmersion j] :
    (Etale.openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
        (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) T).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ≅
      (comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) X).mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙
        (openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) j).mapDerivedCategoryPlus
